dataset.title: Crude oil net imports (EIA, derived)

indicator.name: Crude oil net imports (imports − exports)
indicator.description: EIA crude oil imports minus exports for the same country and year, in TBPD (thousand barrels per day). Positive = net importer, negative = net exporter.

source.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), International Energy Statistics
source.license: Public domain (U.S. Government data); EIA asks to be credited as the source
source.citation: Derived from U.S. EIA International Energy Statistics exports "petrol-import-SeriesExport-10-12-2026-18-11-05.json" and "petrol-export-SeriesExport-10-12-2026-18-11-17.json".

notes: Computed by npm run data:import from eia-crude-oil-imports and eia-crude-oil-exports: for each entity, the latest year in which both have a number. Entities with no such year are kept as missing.
Both inputs state the same unit (TBPD); the importer refuses to combine series with different units.
caveats: Absolute volume in source units: not adjusted for consumption, population or economy size, so large economies dominate. It shows the net trade balance, not a dependence share.
Crude oil only: refined products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, fuel oil) are not in this series, so places that import only refined products show 0 or no data.

scoring.rationale: Net trade volume in absolute units; without consumption of the same fuel it is not a dependence share, so it is context only.
